title: Tapwater exposures, residential risk, and mitigation in a PFAS-impacted-groundwater community
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00005J, Paper

Paul M. Bradley, Kristin M. Romanok, Kelly L. Smalling, Lee Donahue, Mark P. Gaikowski, Randy K. Hines, Sara E. Breitmeyer, Stephanie E. Gordon, Keith A. Loftin, Richard Blaine McCleskey, Shannon M. Meppelink, Molly L. Schreiner
Assessment in a hydrologically-vulnerable, Mississippi River community revealed cumulative risks from co-occurring inorganic/organic contaminants, including PFAS, in alluvial-aquifer-sourced tapwater but not in deeper, sandstone-aquifer tapwater.
